entities.name: Flowstone
entities.description: Silvery substance made in the Stronghold's reactor core, used by the Phyrexians to increase Rath's mass and overlay it onto Dominaria.

entities.name: Death Pits
entities.description: Where impurities from making flowstone were ejected.

entities.name: Rathi overlay
entities.description: Overlay of Rath onto Dominaria, leaving flowstone deposits.

events.summary: After the Rathi overlay large deposits of flowstone remain on Dominaria and spellcasters appear who control it.
events.quote: a new kind of spellcaster appeared, specialized in controlling flowstone and drawing power from it

relations.quote: used by the Phyrexians to increase the mass of Rath
